notes.text: Security update for apache2
notes.title: Title of the patch

notes.text:
This update for apache2 fixes the following issues:

Security issues fixed:

- CVE-2026-42356: deployment of wrong handler allows target of internal redirects from CGI programs to also be treated
  as CGI and executed (bsc#1284043).
- CVE-2026-42528: memory calculation bug in `mod_dav` allows an attacker with permission to create WebDAV locks to crash
  server child processes (bsc#1284044).
- CVE-2026-46729: NULL pointer dereference in `mod_heartmonitor` over unicast listener (bsc#1284045).
- CVE-2026-47360: session cookie passed to a backend server when `SessionCookieRemove` changes across internal redirects
  (bsc#1284046).
- CVE-2026-48005: missing authentication checks in `mod_auth_digest` allows an unauthenticated remote client to cause a
  DoS via forged `Authorization` headers when Digest authentication is enabled with `AuthDigestNcCheck` (bsc#1284047).
- CVE-2026-56153: out-of-bounds write in `mod_charset_lite` (bsc#1284048).
- CVE-2026-56154: use-after-free in `mod_rewrite` when using lookahead `(%{LA-U:HTTP:...})` (bsc#1284049).
- CVE-2026-57941: use-after-free in `mod_http2` via shared `session->bbtmp` re-entrancy (bsc#1284050).
- CVE-2026-58415: internal state files accessible to external parties in `mod_dav_fs` allows a remote client to read
  WebDAV dead properties of resources it cannot author via a GET request for the .DAV state directory (bsc#1284051).
- CVE-2026-59797: improper privilege management in `mod_ssl` when using `SSLRequire` and file-related expressions
  (bsc#1284059).
- CVE-2026-63045: improper validation of FTP PASV reply address in `mod_proxy_ftp` allows an untrusted FTP server to
  cause a proxy to open a data connection to an arbitrary third-party host (bsc#1284060).
- CVE-2026-63292: stack-based buffer overflow in `mod_vhost_alias` allows a remote client to cause a DoS or potentially
  execute arbitrary code via an HTTP request with a specially crafted `Host` header (bsc#1284061).
- CVE-2026-63686: NULL pointer dereference in `mod_xml2enc` allows an untrusted backend server to cause a denial of
  service via a crafted proxied response (bsc#1284058).
- CVE-2026-63718: inconsistent interpretation of HTTP requests in `mod_proxy_uwsgi` allows for response smuggling via a
  crafted uwsgi response with `Transfer-Encoding` (bsc#1284057).
- CVE-2026-73636: authentication bypass by capture-replay in `mod_auth_digest` allows a MiTM attacker to replay captured
  digest authentication credentials via crafted requests (bsc#1284056).
- CVE-2026-73637: use-after-free in `mod_auth_digest` allows an unauthenticated remote client to cause authentication
  state corruption via concurrent Digest authentication requests (bsc#1284055).
- CVE-2026-79768: path equivalence issue in the `mod_userdir` module when configured with absolute non-wildcard
  `UserDir` directive (bsc#1284054).
- CVE-2026-93546: integer overflow in `mod_dav_fs` allows an authenticated WebDAV client with write access to crash
  worker processes and persistently corrupt a directory's property database (bsc#1284053).
- CVE-2026-106023: mod_md NULL pointer dereference leads to child process crash (bsc#1290167).
- CVE-2026-109163: mod_vhost_alias 1 byte stack buffer overwrite (bsc#1290169).
- CVE-2026-119618: mod_http2: heap corruption and RCE in assign_headers (bsc#1290166).

Non security issue fixed:

- Severe CPU Usage regression in webserving, from Tumbleweed April to July (bsc#1246913).

Changes for apache2:

- Update to 2.4.71:
 * Security fixes:
 + bsc#1290166 / CVE-2026-119618: mod_http2: fix heap corruption
 and possible remote code execution in assign_headers().
 + bsc#1290167 / CVE-2026-106023: mod_md: fix a NULL pointer
 dereference leading to a child process crash.
 + bsc#1290169 / CVE-2026-109163: mod_vhost_alias: fix a 1 byte
 stack buffer overwrite.
 * mod_md: MDHttpProxy and MDCACertificateFile can now be set per
 MDomain. New directive MDHttpProxyCACertificateFile sets the CA
 certificates used to verify an HTTPS proxy.
 * mod_deflate: fix inflation of gzip streams that carry an extra
 field.
 * mod_remoteip: apply RemoteIP{Trusted,Internal}ProxyList to the
 virtual host they are configured in, and merge the proxy entries
 of the main server and of the virtual host (PR 70207).
 * mod_remoteip: log a connection closed before a complete PROXY
 protocol header was received at info level (PR 63893).
 * mod_dav: fix handling of invalid or overflowing "Timeout:"
 request headers (PR 65788).
 * mod_http2: correctly handle the asterisk-form of OPTIONS
 requests (PR 70195), fix duplicate logging of header limit
 violations, and fix a crash with "H2PushDiarySize 0" and debug
 logging enabled.
 * mod_dav_lock: fix reading the indirect-lock key length on
 big-endian platforms (PR 70299).
- Changes in 2.4.70:
 * mod_authnz_ldap: fix crashes reported with 2.4.69 (PR 70261).
 * mod_cgid: increase limits for number and length of environment
 variables, URI and arguments (PR 70270).
 * mod_substitute: fix an integer overflow (PR 66034).
 * mod_cache: do not store a response whose "Vary: *" was set via
 "Header always" (PR 70289).
 * mod_dav_lock: fix a heap buffer overflow in dav_size_indirect()
 (PR 70298).
- Fix severe CPU usage / performance drop with OpenSSL 3.5, caused by
 mod_ssl reseeding the OpenSSL PRNG on every new TLS connection
 (bsc#1282733, bsc#1246913):
 * With OpenSSL 1.1.1 and later, mod_ssl and ab no longer seed the
 OpenSSL PRNG themselves; the SSLRandomSeed directive is ignored
 and only logs a deprecation warning.
 * Comment out the SSLRandomSeed directives in the default
 ssl-global.conf.
- Fix the apache_mmn provides (bsc#1286911). The macro scanned the
 whole source tarball, and since 2.4.69 it also matched a line in
 test/pytest_suite/tests/t/apache/test_mmn.py, generating
 apache_mmn_201202110 instead of apache_mmn_20120211. Only parse
 include/ap_mmn.h, stop at the first match, and fail the build in
 the prep section if the provides does not match the sources.
- Update to 2.4.69:
 + bsc#1284043 / CVE-2026-42356: core: don't use the content type
 as a handler for internal redirects from CGI programs.
 + bsc#1284044 / CVE-2026-42528: mod_dav: limit the number of
 active locks.
 + bsc#1284045 / CVE-2026-46729: mod_heartmonitor: validate body
 and query of heartbeat requests.
 + bsc#1284046 / CVE-2026-47360: mod_session_cookie: remove the
 session cookie consistently across internal redirects.
 + bsc#1284047 / CVE-2026-48005, bsc#1284055 / CVE-2026-73637,
 bsc#1284056 / CVE-2026-73636: mod_auth_digest: rewrite shared
 memory and client nonce handling, fix AuthDigestNcCheck and
 one-time nonce replay checks.
 + bsc#1284048 / CVE-2026-56153: mod_charset_lite: handle
 incomplete characters.
 + bsc#1284049 / CVE-2026-56154: mod_rewrite: copy lookahead
 values.
 + bsc#1284050 / CVE-2026-57941: mod_http2: careful handling of
 the session bbtmp brigade.
 + bsc#1284051 / CVE-2026-58415: mod_dav_fs: block access to the
 .DAV state directory.
 + bsc#1284053 / CVE-2026-93546: mod_dav_fs: limit the number of
 namespaces in the property database.
 + bsc#1284054 / CVE-2026-79768: mod_userdir: fix the absolute
 UserDir path check.
 + bsc#1284057 / CVE-2026-63718: mod_proxy_uwsgi: drop hop-by-hop
 headers from uwsgi responses.
 + bsc#1284058 / CVE-2026-63686: mod_xml2enc: handle incomplete
 input.
 + bsc#1284059 / CVE-2026-59797: mod_ssl: don't expose file
 functions in SSLRequire.
 + bsc#1284060 / CVE-2026-63045: mod_proxy_ftp: check PASV
 addresses.
 + bsc#1284061 / CVE-2026-63292: mod_vhost_alias: harden
 interpolation.
 * mod_auth_digest: drop RFC 2069 support. AuthDigestQop now only
 accepts "auth"; "AuthDigestQop none" is a configuration error.
 The "authdigest-opaque" mutex and the unimplemented
 AuthDigestNonceFormat directive have been removed.
 * mod_auth_digest: fix compatibility with expression-based
 AuthName (PR 59039).
 * mod_md: MDServerStatus is now disabled by default.
 * core: reject control characters in the reason phrase of interim
 responses.
 * mod_substitute: fix SubstituteMaxLineLength overflow and a crash
 with a missing closing delimiter.
 * mod_dir: fix a crash for a request not mapped to any type
 (PR 68527).
 * mod_http2: drain open streams on a graceful GOAWAY instead of
 dropping in-flight responses.
 * mod_cgid, mod_ssl, mod_md, mod_lbmethod_heartbeat: various
 hardening fixes.
- Changes in 2.4.68:
 * Includes the fixes for CVE-2026-29167, CVE-2026-29170,
 CVE-2026-34355, CVE-2026-34356, CVE-2026-42535, CVE-2026-42536,
 CVE-2026-43951, CVE-2026-44119, CVE-2026-44185, CVE-2026-44186,
 CVE-2026-44631, CVE-2026-48913 and CVE-2026-49975, previously
 carried as patches.
 * mod_ssl, ab: add support for OpenSSL 4.0.
 * mod_ssl: add SerialNumber as a recognized DN attribute; set the
 auth type to "ClientCert" after client certificate
 authentication.
 * mod_include: don't print any if/elsif/else content when a
 conditional evaluation fails.
 * mod_file_cache: fix crashes for mmap'ed files under threaded
 MPMs (PR 69901).
 * core: add %{m}t to ErrorLogFormat for millisecond resolution.
 * mod_http2: update to 2.0.42.
 * mod_dav_fs: return 404 for DELETE if the resource no longer
 exists (PR 60746).
 * mod_proxy_hcheck: fix health checks disabled by a child restart.
- Changes in 2.4.67:
 * Includes the fixes for CVE-2026-23918, CVE-2026-24072,
 CVE-2026-28780, CVE-2026-29168, CVE-2026-29169, CVE-2026-33006,
 CVE-2026-33007, CVE-2026-33523, CVE-2026-33857, CVE-2026-34032
 and CVE-2026-34059, previously carried as patches.
 * mod_md: update to 2.6.10; mod_http2: update to 2.0.39.
- Update the bundled test framework from svn1929573 to
 git20260829.4c187f2 (apache/httpd-tests, with the Apache-Test
 submodule at perl-apache-test ed33bc9265). The old snapshot
 predates the 2.4.68 mod_include change that hides conditional
 content when an expression fails to parse, so t/modules/include.t
 failed against 2.4.69.

Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server's mod_session_cookie module.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.4.69, which fixes this issue.

Stack-based buffer overflow in mod_vhost_alias in Apache Software Foundation Apache HTTP Server through 2.4.68 on all platforms allows a remote client to cause a denial of service or potentially execute arbitrary code via an HTTP request with a Host header exceeding 8192 bytes when VirtualDocumentRoot uses a hostname format specifier and LimitRequestFieldSize is raised above the default.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.4.69, which fixes this issue.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.4.69, which fixes this issue.

notes.text:
Authentication bypass by capture-replay in mod_auth_digest in Apache Software Foundation Apache HTTP Server 2.4.x on all platforms allows a man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacker to replay captured digest authentication credentials via crafted requests that trigger garbage collection of the client's shared memory entry when AuthDigestNonceLifetime is set to 0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.4.69, which fixes this issue.
notes.title: CVE description

remediations.details: To install this SUSE Security Update use the SUSE recommended installation methods like YaST online_update or "zypper patch".

notes.text:

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.4.69, which fixes this issue.
